description: Type the stale-version failure of PatchConfig and PutConfig. The spec documents `If-Match` as optimistic concurrency control but declares no precondition error; the only 409 it declares is the generic ClerkErrors Conflict. Live probes on 2026-10-02 (disposable application, development instance) returned 409 — never 412 — with errors[0].code `config_version_conflict` and meta { current_version, provided_version } for every non-matching If-Match: a fabricated version, a quoted ETag, `*`, a dry_run, and a PUT. The version is scoped to the request's keys: If-Match must be the config_version of a GET with `keys` set to exactly the patched keys, and the full-document GET version is rejected for a single-key delta. A matching version succeeded, including a no-op. The dedicated ConfigVersionConflict tag (status 409 + body /errors/0/code) lets callers re-read and retry without matching message text; other 409s stay Conflict.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The If-Match config version is not the current version of the keys being written (Clerk `config_version_conflict`, HTTP 409). Re-read the config with `keys` set to the keys being written and retry with its config_version.
